question: Choose the correct **one-word substitute **for: 'A person who is indifferent to pain or pleasure'.
solution: The correct answer is: **Stoic**. (दुःख या सुख में समान रहने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** Despite the harsh criticism, she remained stoic and continued to perform her duties with determination. • The meaning of **"indifferent to pain or pleasure"** aligns perfectly with the word "Stoic." (दुःख और सुख के प्रति उदासीनता) • **Example:** He faced the challenges of life with a stoic demeanor, never letting his emotions get in the way. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Stoic**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Apathetic** (उदासीन): Showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern. • **Example:** The student was apathetic towards extracurricular activities and focused solely on academics. • **Ascetic** (साधु जैसा): A person who practices severe self-discipline and abstention from all forms of indulgence, typically for religious reasons. • **Example:** The monk lived an ascetic life in the mountains, far from the luxuries of the city. • **Hedonist** (भोगवादी): A person who believes that the pursuit of pleasure is the most important thing in life. • **Example:** He was known as a hedonist who spent all his time seeking enjoyment and indulgence. 37:Ta29, The correct answer is: **Dusky**.
